title: 50% off Etihad rail tickets: UAE opens passenger bookings with fares from Dh55
summary: Etihad Rail has launched ticket bookings for its inaugural passenger train service, connecting Abu Dhabi and Fujairah from June 30. An introductory 50% discount makes tickets as low as Dh55.
